item.description: Amazon Redshift now supports multi-statement transactions, automatic write-conflict resolution, and time travel for Apache Iceberg tables. item.title: [75] AWS Backup adds logically air-gapped vault support for Amazon RDS
item.description: AWS Backup logically air-gapped vault now supports Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) DB instances.
